title: Peace
description: Real peace isn't just the absence of noise or trouble — it's the deep calm that comes from trusting God, even in hard circumstances.

waypoints.title: A Different Kind of Calm
waypoints.body: Jesus told his followers he was leaving them a peace unlike anything the world offers -- one that doesn't depend on circumstances going well.

waypoints.title: What Helps You Feel Calm
waypoints.body: What helps you feel calm and peaceful when you're worried?
